Bill.BriefDescription: Permitting counties to direct an existing portion of local lodging taxes to programs for arts and heritage.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to permitting counties to direct an existingportion of local lodging taxes to programs for arts and heritage; andamending RCW 67.28.180.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 67.28.180 and 2010 1st sp.s. c 26 s 8 are each amendedto read as follows:

(i) No taxes collected under this section may be used for theoperation or maintenance of a public stadium that is financed directlyor indirectly by bonds to which the tax is pledged.
